calls.title: Fixter & GrowthBook Follow up
calls.summary: The discussion focused on significant usability and stability issues users face with the current testing tool, particularly relating to persistent crashes and formatting problems affecting text editing, especially for Fiona. The limitations in selecting elements and the disabled AI features have restricted user control in experiment design. Visibility constraints affecting sample and archived experiments create workflow interruptions. The technical support strategy was enhanced with a proposal to establish a dedicated Slack channel for real-time troubleshooting, which aims to replace ad hoc fixes with structured guidance. There was also a push for dynamic visualization of experiment results and segmentation metrics to provide deeper insights into outcomes. Overall, there is a clear focus on improving user experience and enabling better experiment management.
calls.keywords: experiment formatting, tool crashing, GrowthBook setup, traffic allocation, conversion rate metrics, troubleshooting support
